patterns: First-look stack wins the morning: THE TAKE (Denzel, Pattinson, Daisy Edgar-Jones) first look 1.02M + poster 534K on DiscussingFilm, echoed by FilmUpdates (192K poster, 90K stills) and CinemaTweets1 (9.5K).
Hard-news shock still tops lists: Russell Brand sentencing 712K. Sam Claflin / Mckenna Grace Instagram comment is the single biggest post at 2.14M (FilmUpdates).
Box-office milestones keep printing: Godzilla Minus Zero record $31.6M international open + Ghidorah look 746K; Clayface passes $100M (521K, 34K likes); Wicker $29M on $10M (127K).
Prime Video slate day on FilmUpdates: Overcompensating S2 first looks (211K, 207K), Maxton Hall S3 trailer (186K), Heated Rivalry 4DX (107K / 176K on DiscussingFilm).
Gaming crossovers reach film audiences: GTA 6 music festival 274K, Marvel Rivals tease 234K.

Engagement formats on smaller accounts: CinemaTweets1 'Pick One.' (24.6K) and 'User vs. Letterboxd' (26.5K); ATRightMovies classic clips (Empire Strikes Back TV intro 99K, Mila Kunis junket 75K, Terminator gun store 51K).
narrative_synthesis: THE TAKE first look owned the morning: Denzel, Pattinson and Daisy Edgar-Jones in a Netflix heist thriller hit 1,018,210 views on DiscussingFilm in about three hours, with the poster at 534,472. The single biggest original was FilmUpdates' Sam Claflin / Mckenna Grace comment post at 2,144,674. Secondary lanes: Russell Brand sentencing (712K), Godzilla Minus Zero's record $31.6M opening plus Ghidorah (746K), Clayface past $100M (521K), Prime Video slate (Overcompensating S2, Maxton Hall S3). Watchlist originals at 5K+ views: 60 (RealEmirHan silent). Meta: star-cast first looks and box-office records beat everything except celebrity social moments.
